text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The fated day of the Japanese Derby
has arrived.
Parcae's calculations have
yet to bring the
seven-centimeter gap
down to zero.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The venue bustles with spectators here
to see the
crowning of a Derby
champion. While the stands
swell with
anticipation and excitement...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The racers waiting on standby are mired
in a
thicker than usual blanket of anxiety
and tension.
One particular competitor
seems especially
agitated.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
E-excuse me... Air Shakur? I'm currently

conducting pre-race interviews and was

wondering if—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Whaddya want?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry for bothering you!

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Air Shakur certainly seems to be
in a mood...

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Nah, that's just how she always is. You
can't really blame
her for being touchy
before a major race, though.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite being fated to lose, she still
wants to
win... She must be struggling to
reconcile the
reality of the situation with
her desires.
choice_data_list: （違う、不安なんだ）

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Quit that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You've been starin' at me like an idiot
for ages,
and it's seriously pissin' me off.
If you got
somethin' to say, say it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She managed to identify the
seven-centimeter
gap and also whittle it
down to three all on her
own. Is there
really anything I can even say to
her?
choice_data_list: （……何ができるのだろうか？）

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I believe that if I do what I must, the two
of us will
see eye-to-eye one day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Do what I must... As a trainer, I need to
assuage
Shakur's nerves so she can take
on the race with
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If people want to take up all the oxygen
in the
room makin' noise, then I'll just
keep
brainstorming solutions till the very
last second.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Just three more centimeters... Just three more measly centimeters... If I can get this down to zero...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Screw it. I'm redoing it from scratch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't have time to second-guess things.
If I want
to help her, I have to believe in
myself and take
action.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If I take responsibility for what I tell her
and am
prepared to see it through, Air
Shakur should be
willing to hear me out.
choice_data_list: （彼女に伝えたいことがある）

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Dammit! Again with this stupid
991031021222
nonsense! Go away
already!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe even you're hell-bent on
tickin' me
off, Parcae!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: シャカール！

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Finally got the nerve to speak up?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead, then. I'm all ears. Not like I
can't guess
what you're about to say.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You want me to shut up, right? You
think I'm
pathetic for getting all worked
up like a total
idiot, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I bet you think everything I've done so
far has
been for naught and that I should
just give up and
accept my fate.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Then again, knowin' you, you might just
wanna
say somethin' about how I should
enjoy the Derby
since it's a
once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
We won't know how things'll turn out till
it's over
with, and it's gonna start all the
same, whether I'm
calm or not, so the
only thing to do is run... Blah,
blah, blah.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Come on, what're you so scared to say
to me,
huh? Spit it out already.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What?
choice_data_list: 怖くて当たり前だろう
怖くて当たり前でしょう

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The partner she has absolute faith in has

predicted that she's destined to lose. Of
course
she would feel scared.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In her world and in the reality she lives,
that
forecasted timeline is what will go
down in
history. But for me...
choice_data_list: 君にとってデータが絶対なんだよな
貴方にとってデータが絶対なんだよね

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: 俺の現実では、君が最強だ！
私の現実では、貴方が最強だよ！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It hasn't been long since we first met,
but I know
the source of her strength
stems from all the hard
work she's put in
over time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Changing your worldview changes what
you see.
I'm not sure my words are
enough to convey that,
but I have to try!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...
...Is that it?
choice_data_list: 今目の前にいる君なら、運命を超えられる
今目の前にいる貴方なら、運命を超えられる

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: 君の“意地”を貫いて！
貴方の“意地”を貫いて！

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...
Your logic isn't sound.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you must know something like
that would
never convince me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So why'd you even bother? You
should've let me
be, like always.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Okay, and?
choice_data_list: 俺にも意地があるから
私にも意地があるから

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: 君に自分を信じてほしい
貴方に自分を信じてほしい

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I just told you that kinda talk's not
going to
work on me.
choice_data_list: 悪夢はここで全て断ち切ろう

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Siiigh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Anyway, it's time.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: （きっと、伝わったはずだ）

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hmph...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...I get it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Those dreams are over.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I go to put her laptop away after Air
Shakur
leaves, and something on the
screen catches my
eye.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not only that, but Parcae has finished
some new
calculations. And the result
is...
